correctness.rationale: The defining common cutoff with epsilon=1/2, M=2 makes the continuous norm image of the path-connected complex unit sphere lie wholly below 1/2 or above 2. Therefore one operator power has norm<1 or minimum modulus>1. Submultiplicativity and supermultiplicativity give uniform collapse/divergence, and Fekete/Gelfand give precisely the strict scalar inequalities, including m(T)=0 and T quasinilpotent. No spectral splitting is assumed. The diag(1/2,2) and 2S examples verify the very different spectral and minimum-modulus boundaries.
